    The dual of a finite-dimensional algebra as a left module #

    For a k-algebra A, DA k A = Hom_k(A, k) is a left A-module by (a • λ)(b) = λ(b a). For a left A-module W, Hom_A(W, DA) is the k-dual of W (homDAEquiv), and Hom_A(W, DAⁿ) is the dual of Wⁿ (theta, thetaInv).
